description: The Commissariat à la Sécurité Alimentaire et à la Résilience (CSAR), formerly the Commissariat à la Sécurité Alimentaire, runs Senegal's agricultural market information system (SIM). Pages read on 2026-09-29 offer SIM bulletins for download, a price consultation for food products, a map of the markets monitored, a statistics dashboard, a map of CSAR shops and warehouses used for stock management, and annual activity reports for 2024 and 2025. The access policy on the site says detailed collection data are not published freely: only validated statistics and bulletins approved by CSAR headquarters are released, and other data can be requested through a form. Coverage: national, Senegal, monitored rural and urban markets. Format and access: free bulletins and web views; detailed data on request. Licence: not stated. Caveats: the raw market-level price series are not open; the old address csa.sn no longer answers. Simulation uses: food supply and price baselines for disruption and emergency food response studies, and locations of food stores for supply chain models. Related records: compare with the FEWS NET data explorer (data-fews-net-data-explorer) and Mozambique's agricultural statistics (data-maap-mozambique-agricultural-statistics-iai).
